resolutions.researcher_notes: 2 independent Chinese-language sources, not GEM-derived, not tracing to one wire story. china5e.com (中国能源网), 2019-10-09: reports the 闸口输气站至湛江输气站段 (Zhakou-to-Zhanjiang gas-station section, part of 粤西支线北海至茂名段 = the Beihai-Maoming branch) commissioned/put into service 2019-10-08 ('顺利投产'). gdzjdaily.com.cn (湛江云媒/Zhanjiang municipal media), 2022-08-09, via Wayback snapshot: reports the branch's full commercial operation beginning 2022-08-08 once it reached Maoming station ('粤西支线全面投入运营实现商业输气'). Together: a real, staged-into-service, currently operating gas transmission pipeline — supports Status=operating. VERIFIER NOTE: the live gdzjdaily.com.cn URL false-negatived on CJK substrings for a prior researcher (encoding issue); citing the Wayback snapshot (20250825132255) instead, which passes url_verifier cleanly.

Both sources explicitly describe this as a 天然气 (natural gas) transmission pipeline: china5e names the parent entity '中国石化天然气分公司' (Sinopec Natural Gas Company) operating the branch, fed by the Beihai LNG receiving terminal; gdzjdaily calls it '重要天然气能源通道' (an important natural-gas energy corridor) delivering gas to Zhanjiang-area gas utilities. Supports Fuel=Gas.

gdzjdaily.com.cn (2022-08-09), via Wayback snapshot: '8月8日，广西管道公司粤西支线茂名输气站开始向广东省管网连续平稳输气300万方，标志着粤西支线全面投入运营实现商业输气' — an EXACT match to StartYear1=2022/StartMonth1=8. Not listing china5e.com as a second ref here even though it's cited for Status/Fuel/Location: its 2019-10-08 date is for an earlier, different milestone (partial-segment commissioning of just 闸口-湛江, not the full branch reaching commercial operation), so it does not itself support the specific 2022-08 value — noting it only as background (the branch's genuine staged buildout culminating in the 2022-08 full-operation date this ref supports), not as corroboration of the date itself. Single strong source; tier=medium/independent=false.

gdzjdaily.com.cn: '广西管道粤西支线...年设计输气能力33亿方' (Yuexi/Beihai-Maoming branch annual design gas-transmission capacity: 3.3 billion m3) — an EXACT match to GEM's Capacity=3.30 bcm/y, specifically attributed to this branch. Single clean branch-specific figure; tier=medium/independent=false. NOTE ON A DIFFERENT FIGURE FOUND, NOT CITED: Sinopec's 2020-09 completion/environmental-acceptance report for the whole Guangxi LNG project (trqi.sinopec.com PDF, see Diameter unit below) lists '设计输量 40.5×10^8m3/a' (4.05 bcm/y) in its EIA-vs-actual comparison table for 粤西支线 — but the IDENTICAL '40.5' figure also appears in the same table's rows for the unrelated 主干线 (main trunk, 502km) and 柳州支线 (Liuzhou branch, 29km), i.e. it reads as a network/system-wide throughput design figure duplicated across every line-segment row rather than this branch's own exclusive capacity. Not used, to avoid citing a different metric under this branch's name.

DISAGREEMENT, not a dead end — flagging rather than citing per standing rule 2/'never propose refs for a different value'. GEM records LengthKnown=207.00km for this branch. THREE independent sources consistently give a different figure, all clustering ~203.6-204.5km, none near 207km: (1) gdzjdaily.com.cn 2022-08-09: '全长约204km'; (2) a 2020-07 tender bid document issued by 广西天然气管道有限责任公司 itself (bidcenter.com.cn via Wayback web.archive.org/web/20230927041543) itemizing '粤西支线段（闸口输气站-茂名末站）全长约204Km'; (3) Sinopec's official 2020-09 completion/environmental-protection-acceptance investigation report for the whole Guangxi LNG pipeline project (trqi.sinopec.com PDF, doc_20200928_527694089618.pdf) — its formal EIA-vs-actual comparison table gives 粤西支线（闸口输气站-茂名末站）as 204.53km at the environmental-review stage and 203.63km as actually built ('减少0.90km'), to 2 decimal places. All three sources are independent of each other (municipal media, a construction tender, and Sinopec's own regulatory acceptance filing) and all disagree with GEM's 207.00km by a consistent ~1.2-1.7km (the acceptance-report figure being the most precise and authoritative of the three, and itself ~3.4km short of 207.00). This reads as a genuine Length correction candidate (~203.6-204.5km) for a separate Update pass, not a ref-sweep fill — not citing any of the three as support for the recorded 207.00km value.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Resolves what the prior deep-sweep audit flagged as unverified (rows/P4715.json: 'diameter could not be independently corroborated'). Two independent official/technical sources both state Ф559 for exactly this branch: (1) the 2020-07 tender bid document (bidcenter.com.cn via Wayback), issued by 广西天然气管道有限责任公司 itself, itemizes '粤西支线段（闸口输气站-茂名末站）全长约204Km，管径φ559，材质X65M，设计压力10MPa'; (2) Sinopec's 2020-09 completion/environmental-acceptance report (trqi.sinopec.com PDF) states '粤西支线（闸口输气站-茂名末站）...管道规格Ф559，设计压力10MPa' and its EIA-vs-actual comparison table separately confirms '管径 Φ559mm Φ559mm 与环评一致' (diameter unchanged from EIA to as-built). Both an EXACT match to GEM's Diameter=559mm. VERIFIER NOTE (LARGE PDF false-negative, per url_verifier's own documented caveat): the Sinopec PDF is ~42MB/~200+ pages; url_verifier returns 200 but 'missing expected' on '闸口输气站' because its extractor does not reach the whole document. Manually downloaded and ran `pdftotext -layout`, confirming 84 occurrences of 闸口输气站/Ф559/茂名末站 in the full extracted text, including the exact diameter table cited above — overriding the automated FAIL per the documented large-PDF false-negative procedure (manual pdftotext confirmation, live 200 status).

Cannot cleanly support this compound value as recorded, per the no-different-value rule. StartLocation='Zhakou Transmission Station'/Beihai/Guangxi and EndLocation='Maoming Transmission Station'/Maoming district are now strongly corroborated by TWO independent, first-party-quality sources beyond what the prior deep-sweep audit had: Sinopec's 2020-09 completion/acceptance report states verbatim '粤西支线（闸口输气站-茂名末站）：粤西支线起始于北海市合浦县的闸口输气站，先后经过北海、玉林、湛江和茂名，终止于茂名末站' (starts at Zhakou Transmission Station in Hepu County/Beihai, terminates at Maoming terminal), and china5e.com independently corroborates the same 闸口(Zhakou)->茂名(Maoming) framing. (Same large-PDF verifier false-negative as the Diameter unit — manually confirmed via pdftotext, 84 hits.) BUT EndState/Province is recorded as 'Guangxi', which is wrong — Maoming (茂名市) is a Guangdong-administered prefecture-level city, not Guangxi (this is the SAME attribution bug already flagged by this row's deep-sweep validity leg, rows/P4715.json, recommending EndState/Province -> 'Guangdong'; gdzjdaily's own framing of the branch as connecting '广西和广东...横穿湛江市' is consistent with that). Per task instructions, a disagreement found on any field within the unit routes the whole unit to UNRESOLVED rather than a partial ref; this is a data-fix candidate for the Update workflow (already on record), not a ref-sweep fill. Station-name/city corroboration itself is solid and available (see sources above) whenever the province field gets corrected and a fresh ref request is issued for it.

The bidcenter.com.cn tender notice (archived) names the tendering party as '广西天然气管道有限责任公司（以下简称"广西管道公司"）' — an EXACT match to QCCOwner(业主单位), and this same gloss establishes that '广西管道公司' — the operator name used throughout the 2022 gdzjdaily.com.cn commercial-operation article ('广西管道公司粤西支线茂名输气站开始...') — is the short form of the exact recorded string, not a different/ambiguous company. The same bidcenter notice itemizes this company's asset inventory including the exact 粤西支线段 (Zhakou-Maoming) segment this row covers, confirming the operator attribution is segment-specific. Two independent sources (a construction-tender platform and municipal media), tier high.

Same two sources and same reasoning as Operator [ref] above (广西天然气管道有限责任公司 = 广西管道公司, per the tender document's own gloss). The tender document further states 广西天然气管道有限责任公司 '已建管道长度约735公里...粤西支线段（闸口输气站-茂名末站）全长约204Km' — i.e. this company, in a first-party procurement filing about its own asset base, claims ownership/operation of the built branch by name — direct support for Owner1='Guangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Co Ltd' at 100%. gdzjdaily's 2022 article corroborates the same company (by its short name) bringing the branch into commercial operation. No second, distinct owner is named in either source, consistent with the recorded 100% single-owner structure.
